lessons: Before each wave, check every row's attacker count and mower; any row with 0 attackers and no mower gets a shooter before any other purchase.
Never let sun sit at 0: if income stalls for a full wave, stop buying walls and mines and rebuild sunflowers first.
Sunflowers are the only sun source without falling sun, so shield them with a shooter in front and replant quickly when lost.
Wall-nuts only delay zombies; do not spend 50 sun on them while a row has no shooter.
A mower that fires leaves its row permanently open, so immediately put two shooters in that row.
Cherry bombs and potato mines are one-use, slow-recharging defenses; use them only as emergency backup, never as the main line.
On water rows, place the lily pad first and follow up with a shooter on it right away rather than leaving it empty.
Count sun needed for the next two purchases before spending so one loss does not freeze the economy.

Row 1 had no mower and lost a sun_shroom there; keep that row's defense heavier.
Keep sun for replacing lost plants in the late waves (8-10), when pressure is highest.
